name: CEP: verovatna kiša (visoka vlažnost + niska solarna, prozor 10s)
sql: SELECT device_id, AVG(humidity) AS avg_humidity, AVG(solar_generation) AS avg_solar, "RAIN_LIKELY" AS event_type FROM iot_measurements GROUP BY device_id, TUMBLINGWINDOW(ss, 10) HAVING AVG(humidity) > 78 AND AVG(solar_generation) < 1.5
